title: Olive and the Trail of Clues
checkpoint: Year 1 Autumn 1, week 3 — School readiness — Phase 5: new sounds ue, aw, tch

pages.text: What is this on the path?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl tilting her head at something small on the garden path.

pages.text: A twig sits on the wet path.
pages.illustration: A small twig lying in a shallow puddle on the path.

pages.text: Olive spots a shell next to it.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl noticing a small shell lying beside the twig.
Olive the owl studying the twig and the shell side by side.

pages.text: A nut sits on a leaf.
pages.illustration: A small nut resting on a wide leaf further along the path.
Olive the owl gathering the twig, the shell and the nut into one claw.

pages.text: Olive trots on down the path.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl walking steadily along the path, following the trail.

pages.text: At the end, Olive spots Pip.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl spotting Pip the sparrow waiting at the end of the path.

pages.text: Pip had lost the twig, the shell and the nut.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow looking at the ground near his nest, as if he had been searching for something.

pages.text: Olive sets them down. Pip and Olive grin.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Olive the owl sitting together, both grinning.
